min_chapter_seconds.source: the shortest chapter YouTube is remembered to accept in a video description; not read in YouTube's help pages during this work

min_chapters.source: the fewest chapters YouTube is remembered to need before it shows them; not read in YouTube's help pages during this work

max_title_chars.source: mstack default chosen by the builder: longer chapter titles are cut off in many players; a longer title is a warning, not a failure
